messages:
ana: Morning — PR #1298 is up for another pass. I addressed the logic feedback and left a couple of style nits (naming + small formatting). Asking @devon for a quick review and @max for CI sanity. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pr/1298

devon: grabbing it now. quick skim: one variable `kvcacheKey` is used in two places, would prefer `kv_cache_key` at the package boundary. internal struct field can stay CamelCase if that maps to the runtime C struct.

max: CI looks red on first run, re-running now. saw a flaky timeout in the batcher test earlier. :thinking:

ci-bot: Build #3142 — test_batcher_timeout FAILED (pytest). Relevant snippet:
```
E   TimeoutError: Batcher didn't flush within 2s
  tests/test_batcher.py:78
```

ana: hmm, i'll push a tiny test tweak (increase timeout) if you want me to. also i'll apply the `kv_cache_key` rename at the python API layer and add a comment about the internal field mapping.

devon: yes please. at the callsites keep the external arg name snake_case. i'll accept a comment noting the internal->external name mapping. no other blockers from me.

ana: pushed two commits: `py: rename kvcacheKey -> kv_cache_key (api)` and `tests: relax batcher timeout to 3s`. PTAL.

ci-bot: Build #3143 — all checks passed.

devon: looked again, small docstring nit in runtime/kv_client.py (one-line change). otherwise :shipit: from me.

sara: quick thought — is it worth adding a one-line note in CHANGELOG (internal api changes) so integrators know about the arg rename? up to you.

ana: added a short entry in the changelog and a comment in the client wrapper mapping CamelCase->snake_case.

max: approved and merged in main. Thanks for the quick turnaround everyone :tada:

ana: thanks all! saved us a follow-up rollback. :relieved:
